findings.text: follow-on: the caller list names reckon/calibration.py twice inside one sentence and no second caller follows, so the landed evidence prose reads as if two distinct callers exist where there is one; the sentence is otherwise accurate and no measure depends on it.

follow-on: the manifest discloses under follow_ons that the done-when's set (every tests/ file importing reckon.ledger, 230 files) was narrowed to the 13 files that reference a moved name, and the wider 78-file attempt survives only as a head arm: logs/gate-head.log ends at 14 failed and 851 passed with EXIT=1, while logs/gate-base.log was terminated at 32 per cent with EXIT=143, so those 14 ids carry no base reading. Their failure texts (a retired preflight command answering for crew budget --check, and KeyError 'state' on the picker-assessment path, quoted at logs/gate-head.log:58 and :149) are a pre-existing CLI and state condition with no bearing on a pure code move, so the narrowing does not hold the node; it is recorded because the pair the record declares as baseline_suite and after_suite is narrower than the done-when's stated set.

item_verdicts.diff: Read both committed commits against 38d4c39f; 405ba3f88 is the move and 72d9cdeb1 files the landing fragment, and a line-set comparison of the whole diff shows every non-blank line removed from reckon/ledger.py reappears verbatim somewhere in the change and the only new content is the new module's docstring, the two deferred import blocks and their comments.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done_when names tests/test_every_module_fits_a_worker_window.py plus both modules' head token figures by reckon.crew.routing._tokens_for_bytes; the manifest records the two-arm run and its result, and I reproduced the instrument's three figures from the commit blobs (base ledger 51,666; head ledger 42,735; head run_record 9,665).
item_verdicts.goal: The node goal is to move the run-record composition family out of reckon/ledger.py into reckon/run_record.py so ledger.py fits the worker-window bound; reckon/run_record.py:1-11 declares that family and reckon/ledger.py:3689-3708 re-exports all 19 moved names, with reckon/ledger.py measuring 42,735 estimated tokens against the 45,000 the plan names.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; it records both arms running to their summary lines, states head adds no failure over base, names its logs and its negative control, and discloses the test-set narrowing under follow_ons.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The source prompt's FENCE - SCOPE block grants reckon/ledger.py, reckon/run_record.py, tests/test_calibration.py, tests/test_capabilities.py, the landing fragment and the figures directory; the diff touches three of those (reckon/ledger.py, reckon/run_record.py, the fragment) and nothing else.

justifications.durability: the diff adds no assertion, which is right for a pure move, and the guards are pre-existing and independent of any value a test supplies: tests/test_every_module_fits_a_worker_window.py:69 reddens when the family returns to reckon/ledger.py, which logs/negative-control.log demonstrates, while tests/test_calibration.py:281 would raise AttributeError if the re-export block at reckon/ledger.py:3689 were dropped.
justifications.evidence: logs/targeted-base.log ends at 1 failed and 260 passed in 320.32s and logs/targeted-head.log at 1 failed and 260 passed in 425.73s with the same id, declared complete in the manifest's baseline_suite and after_suite, and logs/negative-control.log shows the width test naming reckon/ledger.py again at 51,666 with EXIT=1; the declared pair is narrower than the done-when's 230-file set, which the manifest discloses at follow_ons.
justifications.fit: reckon/run_record.py:1-11 states the module's purpose in the surrounding idiom and its two deferred imports carry reasoned noqa codes, the changed files leave ruff check and ruff format --check clean and raise no F821 under the declared rule set, and no changed path, symbol or comment carries a plan label or a version, with the one prose defect recorded below.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/run_record.py:1-11 states the family's purpose and reckon/ledger.py:3689-3708 re-exports all 19 moved names, so every existing caller still resolves, and the width the goal targets is met at 42,735 estimated tokens against the 45,000 the plan names.
justifications.reuse: a search over reckon/ for definitions of build_record, per_run_budget, measured_throughput, backend_budget_group, measurement_exclusion_reason and unmeasured_clone_report returns only reckon/run_record.py, so the addition extends the family's owner rather than forking a capability, and reckon/run_store.py owns the separate durable run-file store.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the diff (reckon/ledger.py, reckon/run_record.py, the landing fragment) is inside the source prompt's FENCE - SCOPE grant, and the two permitted test files were left untouched because tests/test_calibration.py:281 and tests/test_capabilities.py:795 patch a name their subjects read through the ledger namespace.
